scope: Fix two previously observed defects; source review only for tray icons, animation, flyout and notifications.

fixes.change: Configure stdout and stderr as UTF-8 before argument parsing or HTTP operations.
fixes.tests: Real dev_seed.py subprocess with PYTHONIOENCODING=cp1252, temporary synthetic credentials and a loopback synthetic HTTP endpoint. No real library or client configuration was touched.
fixes.before: Both assertions failed: successful POST exited 1 with UnicodeEncodeError; HTTP error text was escaped instead of readable Chinese.
fixes.after: 2/2 passed: one submitted proposal, exit 0, exact Chinese output; HTTP 503 remains nonzero and readable.

fixes.change: Runtime service exit loads the failure page without showing or focusing the window. Startup failures retain the default show/focus behavior.
fixes.tests: Execute the real main.cjs entrypoint in a Node VM with Electron, process, timers and IO substitutes. This is explicitly a code test, not native Windows tray acceptance.
fixes.before: Hidden-window and focus-preservation assertions failed; startup-error assertion passed.
fixes.after: 3/3 passed: hidden stays hidden until tray callback, open window gets error content without focus, startup error remains visible.

source_review.evidence: tray-icons.cjs implements the mirrored brand, green center, pending green dot, removed paused center and faded amber warning. main.cjs renders at round(16 * scaleFactor), selects system-integrated light/dark palette and refreshes on nativeTheme.updated.
source_review.limit: No native 16px/150% or light/dark taskbar presentation was verified.

source_review.evidence: main.cjs polls status every 4000ms, detects changed read event ids, animates in 100ms frames for 2000ms and checks Windows animation settings. Icon frames are cached. CSS has a global reduced-motion rule.
source_review.limit: No real display timing or breathing appearance was verified.

source_review.evidence: 368x520 isolated BrowserWindow, tray/work-area placement, blur hiding, brand component, light-mode pale gray/black accept button, pause/resume routes and remaining minutes exist in source.
source_review.limit: No native focus, outside-click, material or pause icon behavior was exercised.

source_review.evidence: Agent-only proposals, support/preference gates, suppression when windows are in focus, 30000ms coalescing and a click callback carrying the first proposal id are implemented.
source_review.limit: No native toast registration, delivery, grouping or click was exercised.

findings.trigger: Three older pending suggestions exist and a notification refers to a newer suggestion.
findings.impact: onFlyoutShown only changes focus id. visible remains shown.slice(0,3), so current falls back to the first older row. The requested new suggestion is neither displayed nor selected; Y/N would act on another row.
findings.next: Make the requested proposal part of the visible slice before choosing the keyboard target.

findings.trigger: Keyboard focus is on pause, open-window or settings instead of the pending list.
findings.impact: The window-wide key handler excludes only input/textarea and modifier keys, so Y/N can accept/reject current even when the list does not have focus. This differs from the product's focus requirement.
findings.next: Give the list a keyboard focus target and scope arrow/Y/N handling to that target.

findings.trigger: Status reports a new pending timestamp, but fetching or parsing the proposal list fails once.
findings.impact: pendingMark is advanced before request/parse success. With no newer suggestion, later polls exit at latestAt <= pendingMark, so the failed notification batch is never collected again.
findings.next: Advance the cursor after the proposal list has been received and parsed successfully.
